subject: Vendor Roster & Contingency Mapping — APAC/EU RFI
messages:
From: Ava Moreno <ava.moreno@finsightcapital.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeVault Security <security@edgevault.io>
Date: Sun, 10 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: vendor roster + contingency mapping for APAC/EU

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our risk review for the trading platform rollout in APAC and EU, procurement/security are requesting a consolidated vendor roster and contingency mapping that shows:

- All subprocessors/operators used for inference and storage (by region)
- Which cloud providers host customer data and where (region-level)
- SLA tiers and documented fallbacks (eg. alternative operator, failover region)
- Evidence: SOC 2 report(s), network egress controls, and operator onboarding checklists

Can you provide a single package or pointer to artifacts we can include in our diligence packet? Ideally we need the high-level roster by EOD 2028-06-19; the security team may follow up with a short audit question set.

Best,
Ava
Procurement — FinSight Capital

(Attachment: RFI_template_v3.xlsx)

Ava — thanks for the note and the template. We can absolutely provide this. Quick plan:

1) Deliver a consolidated roster CSV that maps subprocessors to services and regions (see Operator_Matrix_Q2_2028.csv).
2) Provide a short summary PDF with SLA tiers and primary/secondary failover paths (SaaS_Roster_SLA_Summary.pdf).
3) Point to evidence (SOC 2 Type II, operator onboarding checklists) in a shared Drive folder; we will include a hashed list of documents for audit referencing.

Kimberly and Neha — looping you in for any region-specific caveats (data residency or non-standard contracts).

Requested timeline: initial package by 2028-06-19 end of day PT. If you need earlier slices for legal/security, we can prioritize APAC first.

- SLA summary (SaaS_Roster_SLA_Summary.pdf): shows default SLAs (99.9% regional uptime) and defined failover chains (primary region -> same-cloud fallback -> cross-cloud fallback).
